name: 83204 · Pocatello, ID
findings: ZIP 83204 (Pocatello) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83204 (Pocatello) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 83204 (Pocatello) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).
